title: Sort a Set in Descending Order

blocks.content: Sort a Set in Descending Order
Write a program to create a set that sorts its keys in descending order.

items: Get character inputs from the user and store them in the c1, c2, and c3 variables.
Create a char set called characters that is sorted in descending order.
Add c1, c2, and c3 to the set.

blocks.content: Hint: Use greater<int> as the second argument to create a set sorted in descending order.
